title: You Can't Really Tickle Yourself
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: When you move, your brain predicts the touch before it lands.
So it turns that touch down, and the tickle fades.
In one experiment, people moved one hand, and a robot stroked their other palm.
Add a delay of a fifth of a second, and it tickled more.
Your brain turns down what it sees coming.
